platform: Windows 11 hardware Chrome renderer with the real local Rust bridge, isolated profiles and actual mouse/keyboard input. No public map requests. Native Mac validation remains pending; this turn did not rebuild a native Windows binary.
changes: Globe center fallback uses Earth below the camera when the center ray misses Earth, instead of jumping to the dataset center.
An overview center is kept in the viewport while intentional partly clipped oblique views and close-ups remain available.
N and focused-compass Home recenter an overview or recover a camera looking into space without changing orbital distance; regional North retains focus/tilt/zoom.
Wheel navigation focuses the canvas so N works after the gesture.

Reject raw timed LINES whose bounding sphere would invoke Cesium longitude splitting that cannot retain time/color attributes. Use canonical rendering, replacing any stopped-window subset before starting playback.

baseline_reproduction.expected_failure: N restored heading but kept the overview about 154 pixels below viewport center. Repeated off-center zoom could leave the center ray missing Earth.
baseline_reproduction.track_error: A separate pre-existing raw timed-track longitude-splitting error was reproduced on the earlier Upload Lab frontend; the current pan-direction suite renders without it.
